evals.prompt: My spicepod has a Gemini model with `from: google:gemini-2.5-pro` and `google_api_key: ${ secrets:GOOGLE_API_KEY }`. After upgrading Spice to v2.3.1 the model no longer loads. What changed and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Breaking change in v2.3.0: from: google authenticates against Vertex AI and no longer accepts google_api_key. Replace it with google_project, google_location, and exactly one of google_service_account_path, google_service_account_key, or google_application_default_credentials: true

assertions.name: names_breaking_release
assertions.description: Should date the change to v2.3.0
